newsitem.title: USA: Florida Gaming buys World Jai-Alai.
newsitem.headline: Florida Gaming buys World Jai-Alai.

text.p: Florida Gaming Corp Tuesday said it finalized an agreement to buy World Jai-Alai, making it the largest poker room operator in the state of Florida and the largest jai-alai operator in the world.
Florida Gaming said it bought $21 million of World Jai-Alai's bank debt some time ago. Under the latest deal, it agreed to forgive that debt and agreed to profit-sharing over a 10-year period.

The closing date of the deal is set for December 31, 1996, and is subject to the transfer of gaming permits from World Jai-Alai to Florida Gaming by the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation -- Division of Pari-Mutuel Wagering.
Florida Gaming said its total handle (money wagered) is expected to increase over 1200 percent from its present level of $25 million per year to about $300 million per year.
